strings.onboarding.mic.denied: Microphone access is needed to record your voice. Tap Allow microphone to try again.
strings.onboarding.mic.blocked: Microphone access is off. Open Quill's app settings, choose Permissions, then allow Microphone. Return here to test it.
strings.settings.cleanup.automatic_help: Use the speech provider's active key with a known free cleanup option. Automatic cleanup stays off when no free option is known. Free-tier quotas apply. Choosing a separate provider or model below is a manual choice and may cost money.
strings.onboarding.splash.tagline: Speak, instead of typing, in any app. Quill is 100% free & 100% private.
strings.onboarding.welcome.title: Speak, instead of typing, across your apps. For free.
strings.onboarding.welcome.body: A small bubble floats over the screen. Tap it & speak. Your words appear where your cursor is.
strings.onboarding.key.warning.free_tier: You bring the key - some providers (like Groq) have a free tier to start.
strings.onboarding.key.warning.usage: Your provider may charge for usage - Quill itself is free.
strings.onboarding.key.warning.reading: Take a moment to read this
strings.onboarding.howitworks.title: From voice to text, on your terms
strings.onboarding.howitworks.step1: The bubble starts listening - tap again to send.
strings.onboarding.howitworks.step2: Audio goes straight to your speech-to-text key. No middleman.
strings.onboarding.howitworks.step3: Text drops in at the cursor - chat, email, search, notes.
strings.onboarding.checklist.title: You're connected
strings.onboarding.key.title: Add your key
strings.onboarding.key.body: A key is a long private code from an AI service. It lets Quill send your voice to the AI & get text back over an encrypted connection. Never share your key with anyone.
strings.onboarding.key.where_link: Where do I get a key?
strings.onboarding.key.console_body: Any of these works - pick one for quick steps to get its key. Your key stays on this device.
strings.onboarding.key.guide.title: Get your %1$s key
strings.onboarding.key.guide.groq_steps:
Open https://console.groq.com/keys
Sign in, then choose Create API Key.
Give the key a name, such as Quill, and create it.
Copy the key, return to Quill, and paste it below.
strings.onboarding.key.guide.openai_steps:
Open https://platform.openai.com/api-keys
Sign in and choose Create new secret key.
Copy the new key before closing the dialog.
Return to Quill and paste it below.
strings.onboarding.key.guide.openrouter_steps:
Open https://openrouter.ai/settings/keys
Sign in, then create a new API key.
Name the key Quill and review its spending limit.
Copy the new key, return to Quill, and paste it below.
strings.onboarding.key.guide.gemini_steps:
Open https://aistudio.google.com/api-keys
Sign in to Google AI Studio and accept its terms if asked.
Copy an existing Gemini key, or choose Create API key and select a project.
Return to Quill and paste the key below.
strings.stt.quota.toast: API usage has run out - check your provider plan.
strings.key.error.invalid: That key was rejected (401). Check you copied it fully.
strings.key.error.network: Couldn't reach the provider. Check your connection and try again.
strings.onboarding.mic.title: Allow the microphone
strings.onboarding.mictest.title: Say something
strings.onboarding.mictest.body: Let's check your mic. Speak now - you should see the strokes move.
strings.onboarding.overlay.title: Allow the floating bubble
strings.onboarding.allset.title: You're ready to write
strings.onboarding.allset.body: The bubble is live. Open any app, focus a text field, and give it a try.
strings.onboarding.allset.look: Look for this in the corner of your screen.
strings.history.title: History
strings.history.empty.on_body: Your dictation transcripts show up here. Saved on this device only.
strings.history.empty.off_body: Turn on Save dictation history in Settings to keep transcripts on this device.
strings.history.clear.title: Delete all history?
strings.history.clear.body: This removes all %1$d saved dictations from this device. It can't be undone.
strings.home.banner.a11y_off_text: Accessibility is off - tap to switch it back on.
strings.home.today.last_used_sub: Not yet - tap the bubble to dictate in any app.
strings.home.tip.title: Touch the bubble to move and drop anywhere.
strings.home.tip.text: Long-press to dictate to the clipboard
strings.home.paused.banner_title: Turn Quill on to bring back the bubble.
strings.home.paused.banner_text: The bubble is hidden. Quill stays ready so you can bring it back anytime.
strings.settings.title: Settings
strings.settings.speech.title: Speech & model
strings.settings.speech.language_help: English keeps mixed Hindi-English speech in Roman script ("aaj ka"). Auto-detect or Hindi give native script.
strings.settings.speech.gemini_caveat: Gemini is a chat model asked to transcribe - spoken commands may occasionally be paraphrased instead of written word-for-word.
strings.settings.speech.key_required: No API key saved for %1$s yet. Add one to dictate with this provider.
strings.settings.speech.model_field_hint: Exact model ID from your provider
strings.settings.speech.custom_url_help: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Quill calls <base URL>/audio/transcriptions with your key.
strings.settings.keys.title: API keys
strings.settings.keys.empty_body: Connect a speech provider with your own API key. You can add, switch or remove provider keys here.
strings.settings.keys.banner: Keys are encrypted in this device's keystore and never leave it or appear in logs.
strings.settings.keys.help: Your cleanup model reuses this key unless you add a separate one.
strings.settings.cleanup.title: Cleanup
strings.settings.cleanup.provider_help: Cleanup uses the selected provider and its saved key. All three writing styles apply here. If cleanup fails or takes too long, Quill keeps your original transcript.
strings.settings.cleanup.custom_endpoint: Custom cleanup shares the custom endpoint and key with transcription. Saving a different URL changes both.
strings.settings.cleanup.groq_key: Cleanup always runs on Groq - it uses your saved Groq key, not your active provider's.
strings.settings.cleanup.groq_missing: Cleanup runs on Groq only. Without a saved Groq key it's skipped and the raw transcript is inserted.
strings.settings.style.title: Writing style
strings.settings.style.intro: Match how you write in each app - more formal at work, more relaxed with friends.
strings.settings.style.formal_sub: Full sentences, always punctuated, no contractions
strings.settings.style.neutral_sub: Sentence case, standard punctuation, as you said it
strings.settings.style.needs_cleanup: Writing style rides on the AI cleanup pass - turn on "Clean up with AI" for it to apply.
strings.settings.style.needs_groq: Cleanup runs on Groq only. Without a saved Groq key, writing style won't be applied.
strings.settings.style.words_promise: Styles adjust punctuation, capitalization and contractions during cleanup.
strings.settings.style.help: Style is picked from the app you were in when you started speaking. Custom words are still applied last.
strings.settings.words.title: Custom words
strings.settings.words.body: Teach Quill names and terms it keeps mishearing. Each is matched and replaced after transcription.
strings.settings.words.empty_sub: Tap + to add a name or term
strings.settings.words.err_key: Add an API key in Settings to use voice capture.
strings.settings.words.err_permission: Microphone access is needed to record.
strings.settings.vocab.title: Contacts vocabulary
strings.settings.vocab.body: Import names from your contacts so Quill can learn how the people you know are spelled. Names are stored only on this device and are never sent anywhere.
strings.settings.vocab.import_failed: Couldn't read contacts. The previous import was kept.
strings.settings.vocab.empty_sub: Import from contacts to see them here
strings.settings.vocab.permission_needed: Contacts access is needed to import names. You can grant it in system settings.
strings.settings.vocab.clear_confirm_body: This removes every imported contact name from this device. Your custom words are not affected.
strings.settings.audio.title: Audio & recording
strings.settings.audio.silence_banner: In very noisy places this may not trigger - the max-length limit always applies.
strings.settings.privacy.title: Privacy and History
strings.settings.privacy.banner_title: No Quill account or data server.
strings.settings.privacy.banner_text: Audio goes directly to your speech provider. Optional cleanup sends transcripts to your cleanup provider. Keys and history stay on this device. See Privacy details for transfer and recovery.
strings.settings.privacy.history_sub: Kept on this device, then auto-deleted
strings.settings.privacy.crash_sub: Only if a crash happens - you review first
strings.settings.privacy.diag_help: Reports include the error, app version and device - never your audio, text, clipboard, or key.
strings.settings.bubble.title: Appearance
strings.settings.bubble.help: The light ring keeps the bubble visible on any background.
strings.settings.advanced.title: Advanced
strings.settings.advanced.endpoint_help: For any OpenAI-compatible provider. Changing this re-validates your key.
strings.settings.advanced.keepalive_sub: Helps on phones that kill apps
strings.settings.advanced.battery_sub: Open battery settings → find Quill → allow unrestricted
strings.settings.advanced.clear_confirm_body: This removes your saved key, clears your dictation history and custom words, and resets every setting on this device. It can't be undone.
strings.settings.advanced.reset_confirm_body: Restores all preferences to their defaults. Your API key and dictation history are kept.
strings.settings.about.title: About
strings.settings.about.footer: Made for the speakers, not the typers.
strings.system.recovery.title: Quill stopped typing into apps
strings.system.recovery.banner_text: Return to Quill to finish setup or review keyboard access in Settings.
strings.system.recovery.heading: Let's switch it back on
strings.system.recovery.body: Some phones turn this off to save battery. Turning it back on takes two taps.
strings.system.crash.title: Send crash report?
strings.system.crash.body: Quill closed unexpectedly last time. You can send a report to help fix it - here's exactly what it contains:
strings.system.crash.banner: Sent through your own share sheet - you choose the app, nothing auto-uploads.
strings.reliability.boot.title: Tap to re-activate Quill
strings.reliability.boot.text: Your device restarted. Open Quill to record a dictation.
strings.inject.failed.title: Copied to clipboard
strings.inject.failed.text: Couldn't insert here - paste your dictation manually.
strings.inject.revoked.title: Quill was turned off - copied instead
strings.inject.revoked.text: Accessibility is off, so Quill couldn't insert. Re-enable it, then paste.
strings.home.battery.title: Quill keeps getting stopped
strings.home.battery.text: Open battery settings, find Quill, and set it to Unrestricted so it stops getting killed.
strings.settings.survival.title: Help Quill survive
strings.settings.survival.body: Some phones (Honor, Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, Samsung) aggressively stop background apps. To keep the bubble alive, allow Quill to auto-start / run in the background in your device's app-management settings.
strings.settings.survival.steps:
1. Open your device's app-launch or protected-apps settings.
2. Find Quill in the list.
3. Allow auto-start / background activity (and set battery to Unrestricted).
strings.settings.survival.fallback: Couldn't open it automatically on this device - open Settings ▸ Battery / App management and find Quill manually.
strings.notification.text.hidden: Bubble hidden - tap Show Quill to bring it back.
strings.notification.text.recording: Recording… tap the bubble to stop.
strings.bubble.dismiss.toast: Dictation control hidden. Open Quill to record a dictation.
strings.bubble.bin.label: Drag here to hide
strings.bubble.autoreturn.toast: Quill's back. Drag the bubble to the bin to hide it again.
strings.compliance.rationale.mic: Quill needs the microphone to record what you dictate. Audio is sent only to the speech provider whose key you supply, and is deleted after a successful transcription.
strings.compliance.rationale.overlay: The floating bubble needs permission to display over other apps. That bubble is also what lets Quill record while you're in another app.
strings.compliance.rationale.accessibility: Quill uses accessibility only to detect the focused text field and insert your dictation. It never reads or writes password or banking fields.
strings.compliance.privacy.promise: Quill has no account and runs no server. Your audio and transcripts stay on this device except for the direct, encrypted call to the provider you chose.
strings.compliance.key.required_title: You'll need your own API key
strings.compliance.key.required_body: Quill is bring-your-own-key: it transcribes using your own provider account (e.g. Groq or OpenAI). Without a key, Quill can't transcribe. Your key is encrypted on this device and never sent to us.
strings.compliance.privacy.welcome_pill: Your key, your audio - nothing through our servers
strings.models.fallback: Could not refresh. Showing saved or built-in choices.
strings.models.ranking: Free compatible models appear first, followed by dictation or cleanup candidates. Free-tier quotas apply; check your provider plan. Preview models can change or disappear.
strings.models.custom_refresh: Tap Refresh to check this endpoint’s model list.
strings.onboarding.key.free_note: Provider usage limits and charges apply. Checking your key sends no audio.
strings.onboarding.key.router_note: OpenRouter may charge for transcription. Checking your key sends no audio; your model access and quota determine whether dictation is available.
strings.onboarding.key.format_help: Enter a complete key starting with %1$s.
strings.onboarding.key.unverified: We could not reach the provider to check this key. Your draft is kept securely. Check your connection, then try again.
strings.onboarding.key.storage_error: We could not save your key securely. Keep this screen open and try again.
strings.onboarding.key.read_steps: I have read the steps. I will return to Quill to paste my key.
strings.onboarding.key.browser_error: The browser could not open. Choose a default browser in iOS Settings, then try again.
strings.ios.onboarding.tagline: Speak, instead of typing. Your voice, your provider, your words.
strings.ios.onboarding.welcome_body: Record in Quill, then send your words to the Quill keyboard or copy them into your app.
strings.ios.onboarding.record_body: The same simple tap-to-record flow. Start in Quill, speak, and tap again to turn your voice into text.
strings.ios.onboarding.overlay_limit: iOS does not allow a floating bubble over other apps. Recording starts in Quill; the keyboard inserts the finished text.
strings.ios.onboarding.ready_body: Tap the microphone on Home to record. When your words are ready, send them to the Quill keyboard or copy them into your app.
strings.ios.onboarding.bubble_look: Look for this microphone on Home.
strings.ios.workflow.step1: 1. Start a keyboard session in Quill. The microphone stays active for up to five minutes, with an End action in Quill and the keyboard.
strings.ios.workflow.step2: 2. Return to your app, choose Quill with the globe key, then tap Dictate and speak.
strings.ios.workflow.step3: 3. Tap Stop dictation. Your words appear automatically if the field is unchanged; otherwise use Insert dictation. Manual Send to keyboard is still available.
strings.ios.keyboard.title: Quill keyboard
strings.ios.keyboard.setup_steps: Open Settings → General → Keyboard → Keyboards → Add New Keyboard, then choose Quill. Tap Quill and enable Allow Full Access. Return here and switch keyboards with the globe key to try it.
strings.ios.keyboard.full_access_body: Full Access lets this keyboard control a session you started in Quill and receive its transcripts. Nearby text is used only to place your words; it is not saved or sent. Provider keys and microphone capture stay in Quill.
strings.ios.keyboard.sensitive_limit: iOS switches to the system keyboard for password and phone-number fields. Apps can also disable custom keyboards. Quill cannot insert in those fields. Use Copy only in a field you choose.
strings.ios.keyboard.selection: Tap to place the cursor without a selection before inserting. Your existing text stays intact.
strings.ios.keyboard.field_unavailable: Quill can't insert into this field. Choose an ordinary text field in an app that allows custom keyboards.
strings.ios.keyboard.full_access_needed: Type normally here. To insert a dictation, allow Full Access for Quill in Settings → General → Keyboard → Keyboards.
strings.ios.keyboard.record_help: Open Quill once and start a keyboard session to dictate here. You can also record in Quill, send a transcript and insert it here.
strings.ios.keyboard.transfer_error: Couldn't read that dictation. Return to Quill and send it to the keyboard again.
strings.ios.mic.rationale: Quill uses the microphone for dictation, local tests and keyboard sessions you explicitly start. A keyboard session keeps it active for up to five minutes; idle audio is discarded. Dictation audio goes directly to your chosen provider using your own key.
strings.ios.mic.blocked: Microphone access is off. Open Settings, choose Quill, and enable Microphone. Return here to record.
strings.ios.mic.test_private: This microphone test stays on your device. It is deleted when the test stops and is never uploaded.
strings.ios.keys.label: Key name (optional)
strings.ios.keys.security: Keys are stored in this device's Keychain and excluded from backups and iCloud sync. A key is sent only to its selected provider over HTTPS. Keys never appear in logs or reach the keyboard.
strings.ios.keys.endpoint_binding: Custom keys are bound to the exact HTTPS base URL used when you verify them. After changing the URL, add and verify a key for that endpoint. Speech and custom cleanup share this endpoint.
strings.ios.models.empty: No matching models were returned. The bundled models and manual model ID remain available.
strings.ios.home.title: Ready when you are
strings.ios.home.subtitle: Record here. Insert with your keyboard.
strings.ios.home.no_history: No dictations yet. Try a recording from Home.
strings.ios.home.tip_title: Stay in the app you are using
strings.ios.home.tip_body: Start a keyboard session in Quill once. Return to your app, select the Quill keyboard and use Dictate. Stop to insert your words without another app switch.
strings.ios.result.title: Your dictation
strings.ios.result.copied: Copied. Paste into the field you choose. This copy stays until you replace or clear it.
strings.ios.result.sent: Ready in the Quill keyboard for 60 seconds. Return to your app, switch to Quill, and tap Insert dictation.
strings.ios.transfer.clear: Clear keyboard text and end session
strings.ios.recording.cap_warning: Recording will stop in less than 15 seconds.
strings.ios.recording.retry_retention: Your recording stays on this device until Retry succeeds or you tap Cancel, including in private mode.
strings.ios.history.private: Private mode is on. New transcripts aren't saved. Previous history remains until it expires or you clear it.
strings.ios.history.clear_confirm: Delete every saved dictation? This cannot be undone.
strings.ios.cleanup.inactive: Automatic cleanup is currently off for this provider. Your transcript and custom words still work. Choose a cleanup provider and model to enable it manually.
strings.ios.cleanup.example_before: um can we meet tomorrow at five
strings.ios.cleanup.example_after: Can we meet tomorrow at five?
strings.ios.style.body: Choose how to punctuate and capitalize your dictation. The selected style applies through AI cleanup.
strings.ios.style.app_limit: iOS does not expose the destination app to Quill. Choose a style here before recording; automatic per-app styles aren't available.
strings.ios.contacts.denied: Couldn't import contacts. Allow Contacts for Quill in Settings and try again. Your previous import is kept.
strings.ios.audio.trigger_help: During a keyboard session, use Dictate and Stop dictation in the Quill keyboard. You can also record directly in Quill with the microphone button.
strings.ios.audio.silence_detail: A quiet pause of 3.5 seconds stops recording after a 2-second startup grace. The microphone meter uses the same measured audio level.
strings.ios.audio.route: Quill prefers this device's built-in microphone. Calls, audio input changes or permission changes can interrupt recording and show a recovery action.
strings.ios.visual.help: Control size applies to the microphone button inside Quill. Text size and Reduce Motion follow system accessibility settings.
strings.ios.privacy.direct: Audio goes directly to your speech provider. Optional cleanup sends the transcript to your selected cleanup provider. No Quill account or Quill server handles either. Provider terms and usage charges apply.
strings.ios.privacy.private_detail: Private mode skips new transcript history. It does not erase earlier history. A failed recording is kept locally until Retry succeeds or you discard it. Send to keyboard and Copy are explicit actions you control.
strings.ios.diagnostics.body: Nothing is sent automatically. When enabled, Quill stores only numeric crash, hang and exception counts from iOS. You can review and share those counts with the app version, iOS version, microphone permission and recording state. No keys, recordings, transcripts, contacts, clipboard, provider replies, stack traces or endpoint addresses are included.
strings.ios.diagnostics.enable: Enable reviewed diagnostic reports in Privacy to share this report.
strings.ios.advanced.timeout_detail: Transcription: up to 90 seconds. Cleanup: 4 seconds, then your original transcript is used. Key checks and model refresh: 15 seconds.
strings.ios.advanced.background: A keyboard session explicitly keeps the microphone active for up to five minutes. End it in Quill or the keyboard. Calls, audio-route changes, device locking and system termination can end the session; open Quill to restart it.
strings.ios.about.provider_terms: Quill is free to use. Your speech and cleanup providers may charge for API usage. Choose models and providers according to your own accounts and terms.
strings.ios.notice.title: Quill
strings.ios.error.endpoint: Enter a valid HTTPS base URL without a username, password, query or fragment.
strings.ios.error.no_key: Add and verify a key for your selected speech provider in Settings → API keys.
strings.ios.error.no_speech: No speech was returned. Retry or record again closer to the microphone.
strings.ios.error.rate_limit: The provider is rate-limiting requests. Wait a moment, then tap Retry.
strings.ios.error.provider: The provider couldn't complete this request. Check its service status and model, then tap Retry.
strings.ios.error.response: The provider returned an incomplete or unreadable transcript. Tap Retry or choose another model.
strings.ios.error.audio: Couldn't start the microphone. Allow microphone access and close other recording apps, then try again.
strings.ios.error.storage: Couldn't save data on this device. Check available storage and try again.
strings.ios.error.interrupted: Recording or processing was interrupted. Return to Quill and tap Retry for the captured audio, or Cancel to discard it.
strings.ios.error.expired: That keyboard transfer expired. Send the transcript from Quill again.
strings.ios.recording.cleanup_pending: The last recording data could not be fully removed. Retry cleanup before starting another dictation.
strings.ios.setup.welcome_body: Speak in the apps you already use. Start a timed microphone session once, then dictate with the Quill keyboard.
strings.ios.setup.provider_body: Groq turns your voice into text. Create an API key below, then paste it into Quill. You can add other providers and choose models in Settings.
strings.ios.setup.keyboard_body: Add Quill once in iOS Settings. Then switch to it using the globe whenever you want to insert a dictation.
strings.ios.setup.keyboard_add: Open Settings below. Tap Keyboards, then turn on Quill.
strings.ios.setup.keyboard_access: Turn on Allow Full Access and confirm Allow.
strings.ios.setup.keyboard_return: Return here, tap the field below, and hold the globe to choose Quill.
strings.ios.setup.keyboard_switch: Tap this field and choose Quill from the globe menu. Setup checks the running keyboard; typing alone does not confirm it.
strings.ios.setup.keyboard_connected: Quill keyboard connected with Full Access
strings.ios.setup.practice_body: Start a keyboard session below, select Quill in the practice field, then use Dictate and Stop dictation. Your words appear automatically. You can also record here and send manually. This uses your provider account.
strings.ios.setup.practice_switch: Tap the field below. Choose Quill using the globe, then tap Insert dictation within 60 seconds. If it expires, send the transcript again.
strings.ios.setup.ready_body: Your keyboard and first insertion are ready. Start a session in Quill once, then dictate without leaving your other apps.
strings.ios.setup.ready_pending: You can record in Quill now. Finish keyboard setup and practice to dictate inside your other apps.
strings.ios.setup.flow_record: Start a five-minute keyboard session in Quill.
strings.ios.setup.flow_send: Return to your app and choose the Quill keyboard.
strings.ios.setup.flow_insert: Tap Dictate, speak, then Stop dictation. Your words appear in the same field.
strings.ios.setup.companion_body: The microphone stays in Quill. A timed session lets the keyboard control dictation while you stay in your app.
strings.ios.workspace.title: Start with a thought
strings.ios.workspace.body: Start a keyboard session above to dictate in other apps. Or use the microphone here and review, copy or send the transcript yourself.
strings.ios.setup.example: Let’s move our meeting to Thursday.
strings.ios.setup.flow_short_insert: Dictate and insert from the keyboard
strings.ios.speech.body: Choose how your recordings become text.
strings.ios.session.title: Dictate from your keyboard
strings.ios.session.body: Start a five-minute session, then return to your app. The microphone stays active, including between dictations; idle audio is discarded. Only a take you start with Dictate is saved and sent to your provider. You can end the session at any time.
strings.ios.session.active_body: Return to your app and choose Quill. Tap Dictate, speak, then Stop dictation. Your words appear in the same field. The microphone remains active until you end this session or its timer expires.
strings.ios.session.processing_body: Your words will appear here. If you move or edit the field, choose Insert dictation when ready.
strings.ios.session.failed: The take could not finish. Retry here, or open Quill to fix the key, connection or saved recording.
strings.ios.session.listening: Listening. Tap Stop dictation when you finish.
strings.ios.session.keyboard_ready: Tap Dictate to speak here. The timed microphone session is active in Quill.
strings.ios.session.unavailable: The session is unavailable. Open Quill to start a new keyboard session.
strings.onboarding.key.other_providers: Add other providers later in Settings
strings.onboarding.key.settings_help: Add keys and choose your provider under Speech & model. You can also finish setup now and return here later.
strings.demo.accessibility: Animated dictation example. A delivery question is answered by recording a reply and inserting the finished text into the message field.
strings.demo.question: when will i get my delivery?
strings.demo.reply: You will get it by tomorrow at 12 noon latest. Thanks for your patience.
strings.ios.error.provider_busy: Your provider is temporarily busy. Wait a moment, then retry. You can choose another provider in Speech & model.
